entries.say.1.neutral: Damn {slot.killer.name}. {target.name} was my friend, and this will cost you.
entries.say.2.neutral: I saw {target.name} fall. {slot.killer.name} will answer for it.
entries.say.3.neutral: Hell, {target.name}. What {slot.killer.name} did will not be forgotten.
entries.say.4.neutral: I will not let {target.name} be forgotten, and {slot.killer.name} will not get away with it.
entries.say.5.neutral: {target.name} always had my back. Today, I am coming for {slot.killer.name}.
entries.say.7.neutral: I hope {slot.killer.name} knows what they took from us when they killed {target.name}.
entries.say.8.neutral: No more warnings. {slot.killer.name} killed one of ours, {target.name}.
